title: A little fun with ChatGPT
author: fatheadlifter
selftext:
I'm sure other people are doing more creative stuff than this, but I was plugging this into ChatGPT to have a bit of fun.  If you regenerate this text within the same chat, it can get a bit repetitive.  If you start a new chat with the same text, it seems to regenerate the creative parameters.  Choices of A/B/C can be summarized in response as letters or numbers and it knows what you mean:

"i want to play a game you write where i'm on the oregon trail in the year 2445, 100 years after the apocalypse, big dangers in this world include fast zombies, marauding looters, and big orange men, but not necessarily all of them and not necessarily in that order, and sometimes other surprising dangers and challenges, be creative.  I'm travelling westward to a promised land with a group of survivors that include unarmed children that will sometimes need protection. as the game progresses give me one part of the story and then 3 choices on what to do next.  at least 50% of the choices will end in a horrible demise, and it's very easy to lose. can you do that?"
